he.text: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן חָטָאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ מָלֵא רַחֲמִים רַחֵם עָלַי וְקַבֵּל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃

en.text: Most merciful and gracious God! I have sinned before thee; O Eternal! who art full of compassion, have mercy upon me, and receive my supplications.
